title: What is the Real Asset Thesis for Investable Conservation?
summary: Joining FinextraTV for an episode of Unplugged, Tripp Wall, Founder and CEO, Pantheon Regeneration and Managing Partner, Trailhead Capital discussed his light bulb moment that prompted a new asset thesis for investable conservation. Providing context into his journey from alternative asset management to ecology, philanthropy and environmental regeneration, Wall explained how his financial background created a strong basis for improving existing nature asset frameworks. Wall went on to discuss the use of AI within nature bio-characteristic assesments, the future of sustainable approaches to data centers and, crucially, what epiphany led Wall to develop what he saw as the real asset thesis for nature conservation with return parity with other classes.
